title: ENGINEER PAY RATE CARD — COUNTRY & LOCAL CURRENCY
subtitle: Engineer pay only — no agency margin, no client bill rate | Half-day = 5 hours | Full-day = 8 hours
methodology_note: L1 = junior/first-line | L2 = experienced/second-line | L3 = senior/lead/third-line | Local rates are rounded market-pay benchmarks
important_note: Important: This is engineer compensation/pay, not client billing. Country/level anchors were taken from the researched market-pay ranges; role-by-role rows are calculated benchmarks using role skill premiums/discounts and the country pay anchor. They are suitable for starting offers, then confirm the specific candidate, city, employment model and contract length.

sources.source_list_note: Research sources include IT Jobs Watch, Morgan McKinley, Hays, Robert Half, BLS, Levels.fyi, Lemon.io, Curotec, Arc, Toku and country salary guides.
